"""Physical known-socket observer sensitivity, not runtime qualification."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import select
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from contextlib import ExitStack
from pathlib import Path

assert os.geteuid() == 0 and os.uname().nodename == 'anvil-qa-v1'
base = Path('/var/lib/anvil-qa-v1/runtime-functional')
controls = base / 'controls-e49e149/runtime-checks'
manifest = Path('/tmp/forge-release-e49e149/release.json')
assert hashlib.sha256(manifest.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == sys.argv[1]
release = json.loads(manifest.read_bytes())
image = release['images']['kyc-runtime']
assert release['revision'] == 'e49e149d814d43b8028d11cfe95e7398acbf8318'
assert release['source_sha256'] == 'c26a7965e3ee215aa74e495c5341c15a2e0423f3952a1799111e8eef688201e4'
assert re.fullmatch(r'us-west1-docker.pkg.dev/adi-anvil-mvp-2026/anvil-qa-v1/kyc-runtime@sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}', image)
observer_source = controls / 'network_observer.py'
assert observer_source.stat().st_uid == 0 and not observer_source.stat().st_mode & 0o022
assert hashlib.sha256(observer_source.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == release['operational_files']['runtime-checks/network_observer.py']
helper = Path('/tmp/forge-release-e49e149/observer-helper.py')
assert helper.resolve() == helper and helper.stat().st_uid == 0 and not helper.stat().st_mode & 0o022
assert hashlib.sha256(helper.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'df957d4ae64990047f7a82581c3d3324cba6b3c3e5c8402947d5915c20197929'
code = helper.read_text()
sys.path.insert(0, str(controls))
from network_observer import FilteredSDKObserver, NetworkObserver, complete_trace

bridge, proof = base / 'native-control-bridge', base / 'harbor-proof'
qualification = proof / 'component-qualification'
root = base / 'observer-selftest-e49e149-v1'
root.mkdir(mode=0o700)

def save(folder, name, body):
    raw = body if isinstance(body, bytes) else json.dumps(body, sort_keys=True).encode()
    with os.fdopen(os.open(folder / name, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600), 'wb') as out:
        out.write(raw)
        out.flush()
        os.fsync(out.fileno())

def inspect(value):
    return json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['docker', 'inspect', value], timeout=10))[0]

def profile(info):
    return {'user': info['Config']['User'], 'host': info['HostConfig'], 'mounts': info['Mounts']}

def command(role, case, socket):
    args = ['docker', 'run', '--pull=never', '--name', 'forge-observer-' + role + '-e49-' + case,
        '--label', 'io.adi.forge.scope=observer-selftest-e49', '--read-only', '--user', '0:0' if role == 'sdk' else '10001:10001',
        '--network', 'none', '--cap-drop', 'ALL', '--security-opt', 'no-new-privileges', '--userns', 'host',
        '--memory', '1536m', '--pids-limit', '256', '--cpus', '2', '--tmpfs', '/tmp:rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,size=128m',
        '--mount', f'type=bind,src={bridge},dst={bridge}', '-e', 'ANVIL_ENV=local', '-e', 'WEB_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:3202',
        '-e', 'ANVIL_RUNTIME_IMAGE_DIGEST=' + image.rsplit(':', 1)[1], '-e', 'ANVIL_LIVE_PROVIDERS_ENABLED=false',
        '-e', 'ANVIL_HARBOR_LIVE_PROVIDERS_ENABLED=false', '-e', 'ANVIL_REAL_EMAIL_ENABLED=false']
    if role == 'sdk':
        args += ['--pid', 'host', '--uts', 'host', '--cgroupns', 'host', '--cap-add', 'SYS_PTRACE', '--cap-add', 'DAC_OVERRIDE', '--cap-add', 'CHOWN',
            '--security-opt', 'apparmor=unconfined', '--mount', f'type=bind,src={proof},dst={proof}',
            '--mount', f'type=bind,src={qualification},dst=/opt/anvil-runtime-source/.data/component-qualification,readonly',
            '--mount', 'type=bind,src=/run/docker.sock,dst=/run/docker.sock,readonly', '--mount', 'type=bind,src=/usr/bin/docker,dst=/usr/bin/docker,readonly',
            '--mount', 'type=bind,src=/usr/libexec/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose,dst=/usr/libexec/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose,readonly',
            '-e', 'ANVIL_GOLDEN_NATIVE_COORDINATOR_ENABLED=true', '-e', 'ANVIL_NATIVE_BRIDGE_ROOT=' + str(bridge),
            '-e', 'ANVIL_GOLDEN_NATIVE_WORK_ROOT=' + str(proof / 'native-control-work'),
            '-e', 'ANVIL_HARBOR_DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/docker.sock', '-e', 'ANVIL_HARBOR_PYTHON=/opt/anvil-runtime/bin/python']
    return args + ['--entrypoint', '/opt/anvil-runtime/bin/python', image, '-I', '-B', '-c', code, role, str(socket)]

def terminal_fd(descriptor):
    poller = select.poll()
    poller.register(descriptor, select.POLLIN)
    return bool(poller.poll(5000))

results = []
count_command = 'exec psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -X -A -t -c "SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM banking.commands),(SELECT count(*) FROM banking.execution_jobs)"'
before_jobs = subprocess.check_output(['docker', 'exec', 'anvil-qa-v1-postgres-1', 'sh', '-c', count_command], timeout=15).decode().strip()
assert before_jobs == '0|0'
for case in ('positive', 'negative'):
    evidence = root / case
    evidence.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    directory = bridge / ('.bm-gw-oe49p' if case == 'positive' else '.bm-gw-oe49n')
    directory.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    os.chown(directory, 10001, 10001)
    socket = directory / ('gateway.sock' if case == 'positive' else 'forbidden.sock')
    for role in ('worker', 'sdk'):
        p = subprocess.run(['docker', 'inspect', 'forge-observer-' + role + '-e49-' + case], capture_output=True, timeout=10)
        assert p.returncode == 1 and b'no such' in p.stderr.lower()
    save(evidence, 'intent.json', {'case': case, 'image': image, 'helper_sha256': hashlib.sha256(helper.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        'observer_sha256': hashlib.sha256(observer_source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'expected_socket': str(socket), 'qualification_granted': False})
    observers, before = {}, {}
    with ExitStack() as cleanup:
        try:
            worker = NetworkObserver(command('worker', case, socket), evidence, 'worker', bridge)
            observers['worker'] = worker
            cleanup.callback(worker.abort)
            before['worker'] = profile(inspect(worker.name))
            until = time.monotonic() + 20
            while not (directory / 'ready').exists():
                assert worker.process.poll() is None and time.monotonic() < until, 'Known server startup failed'
                time.sleep(.05)
            sdk = FilteredSDKObserver(command('sdk', case, socket), evidence, 'sdk', bridge)
            observers['sdk'] = sdk
            cleanup.callback(sdk.abort)
            before['sdk'] = profile(inspect(sdk.name))
            summaries = {}
            for role, observer in observers.items():
                stdout, stderr = observer.process.communicate(timeout=60)
                save(evidence, role + '.stdout', stdout)
                save(evidence, role + '.stderr', stderr)
                assert observer.process.returncode == 0
                summaries[role] = json.loads(stdout)
            assert summaries['worker']['accepted'] == 2 and summaries['sdk']['child_exit'] == 0
            assert summaries['sdk']['successful_connect'] == str(socket)
            outcomes = {}
            for role, observer in observers.items():
                assert terminal_fd(observer.descriptor), 'Original tracee not terminal'
                if role == 'sdk':
                    assert terminal_fd(observer.tracer_descriptor), 'Original SDK tracer not terminal'
                error = None
                try:
                    packet = observer.finish()
                except ValueError as caught:
                    error = str(caught)
                    assert case == 'negative' and error == 'Unexpected network family or non-control Unix peer observed'
                if case == 'positive':
                    assert error is None and packet['unix_connect_events'] >= 1 and packet['internet_connect_events'] == 0
                else:
                    assert error is not None
                traces = sorted(evidence.glob(role + '.syscalls.*'))
                assert any(p.name == role + '.syscalls.' + str(observer.pid) for p in traces)
                connected = []
                for path in traces:
                    raw = path.read_bytes()
                    complete_trace(raw)
                    if re.search(r'connect\([^\n]+sun_path="' + re.escape(str(socket)) + r'"[^\n]+\)\s*=\s*0\s*$', raw.decode(), re.M):
                        connected.append(path.name)
                assert connected and all(p != role + '.syscalls.' + str(observer.pid) for p in connected), 'Successful traced descendant required'
                info = inspect(observer.name)
                assert profile(info) == before[role] and info['Config']['Image'] == image
                assert not info['State']['Running'] and not info['State']['Restarting'] and info['State']['Pid'] == 0 and info['State']['ExitCode'] == 0
                outcomes[role] = {'classification': 'accepted' if case == 'positive' else 'expected_forbidden_peer_rejection',
                    'successful_descendant_traces': connected, 'trace_sha256s': {p.name: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in traces},
                    'original_pid': observer.pid, 'original_start_ticks': observer.identity, 'container_id': info['Id'],
                    'profile_sha256': hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(before[role], sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()}
            save(evidence, 'observed.json', {'scope': 'observer_sensitivity_only', 'case': case, 'outcomes': outcomes, 'qualification_granted': False})
            results.append({'case': case, 'outcomes': outcomes})
        finally:
            states = []
            for role in ('worker', 'sdk'):
                name = 'forge-observer-' + role + '-e49-' + case
                try:
                    response = subprocess.run(['docker', 'inspect', name], capture_output=True, timeout=10)
                    if response.returncode == 1 and b'no such' in response.stderr.lower():
                        states.append({'role': role, 'not_created': True})
                        continue
                    info = json.loads(response.stdout)[0]
                    assert info['Name'] == '/' + name and info['Config']['Image'] == image
                    assert info['Config']['Labels'].get('io.adi.forge.scope') == 'observer-selftest-e49'
                    if info['State']['Running']:
                        subprocess.run(['docker', 'stop', '--time', '1', info['Id']], capture_output=True, check=True, timeout=6)
                    info = inspect(info['Id'])
                    assert not info['State']['Running'] and not info['State']['Restarting'] and info['State']['Pid'] == 0
                    states.append({'role': role, 'id': info['Id'], 'terminal': True})
                except BaseException as error:
                    states.append({'role': role, 'unknown_retained': True, 'error_type': type(error).__name__})
            save(evidence, 'cleanup.json', states)
            assert not any(item.get('unknown_retained') for item in states), 'Self-test cleanup requires reconciliation'
after_jobs = subprocess.check_output(['docker', 'exec', 'anvil-qa-v1-postgres-1', 'sh', '-c', count_command], timeout=15).decode().strip()
assert after_jobs == before_jobs
save(root, 'result.json', {'scope': 'observer_sensitivity_only', 'results': results, 'before_jobs': before_jobs, 'after_jobs': after_jobs, 'runtime_qualification_granted': False})
print(json.dumps({'scope': 'observer_sensitivity_only', 'status': 'observed_requires_independent_review', 'evidence': str(root), 'qualification_granted': False}))
